<!doctype html><html lang="ja"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>前後左右上下宇宙大の思い出クイズ</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:#f7f2e9;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans JP",sans-serif;color:#292722}
.app{max-width:680px;margin:auto;padding:12px}.card{background:#fff;min-height:94vh;border-radius:25px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 25px #0001}
.head{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:1000}.prog{text-align:center;font-weight:900;color:#777;margin:14px 0 8px}
.photos{display:grid;gap:7px}.photos.two{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.pic{width:100%;max-height:340px;object-fit:contain;background:#f1ede6;border-radius:18px;margin:4px 0 10px}
.photos.two .pic{height:210px;object-fit:cover}.q{font-size:1.22rem;font-weight:950;line-height:1.55;background:#fff5d8;padding:16px;border-radius:18px}
.opts{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:13px}.opt{border:2px solid #e8e0d5;background:#fff;border-radius:17px;padding:15px;font-size:1.06rem;font-weight:900;text-align:left}
.opt.bad{opacity:.35;text-decoration:line-through}.msg{text-align:center;background:#f5f3ef;border-radius:15px;padding:12px;margin-top:12px;font-weight:900}
.start{width:100%;border:0;background:#ef9444;color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:18px;font-size:1.15rem;font-weight:1000;margin-top:18px}
.home{text-align:center;padding:45px 5px}.emoji{font-size:4rem}.home h1{font-size:1.8rem}.home p{line-height:1.7;color:#6d685f}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#fffaf3f4;z-index:20;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center}
.big{font-size:clamp(3rem,15vw,7rem);font-weight:1000}.ans{font-size:1.4rem;font-weight:1000;margin:14px 20px}
</style></head><body><div class="app"><div class="card"><div class="head">✨ あの日、あの時クイズ ✨</div><div id="s"></div></div></div>
